node.title: DLI Artin-Schreier conductor criterion
node.statement: For an additive phase f on a smooth curve component, the associated Artin-Schreier trace sheaf is geometrically trivial exactly when f differs from a constant by g^p-g; otherwise its conductor is bounded by the reduced polar divisor of f after Artin-Schreier reduction.
node.attack_surface: standard Artin-Schreier sheaf triviality and conductor bookkeeping
node.falsifier: a non-Artin-Schreier rational phase whose additive trace sheaf is geometrically trivial, or whose conductor exceeds its reduced polar-divisor bound
